ja360:1.1: Vāti gandho timirānaṃ, kusamuddo va ghosavā, dūre ito pi Sussondī, Tamba kāmā tudanti man ti.
ja360:2.1: Kathaṃ samuddaṃ atari, kathaṃ addakkhi Serumaṃ, kathaṃ tassā ca tuyhañ ca ahū Sagga samāgamo ti.
ja360:3.1: Bharukaccha-payātānaṃ vāṇijānaṃ dhanesinaṃ makarehi bhinnā nāvā, phalaken' aham aplaviṃ.
ja360:4.1: Sā maṃ saṇhena mudunā niccaṃ candanagandhinī aṃkena uddharī bhaddā mātā puttaṃ va orasaṃ.
ja360:5.1: Sā maṃ annena pānena vatthena sayanena ca attanāpi ca mandakkhī, evaṃ Tamba vijānahīti.
